_comment: Authoritative site data, read at startup by SiteCatalog and applied OVER the inspector.
The device copy at persistentDataPath/buildings.json WINS over this one when present,
so coordinates can be corrected with `adb push` + the HUD reload button, no rebuild.
The only inspector field that selects a site is GeospatialController.siteId.

buildings.name: Synagogue
_notes: BOTH corners are on the FRONT FACADE (2026-08-19 survey), 16.72 m apart on bearing
99.57 deg true, so the facade normal is 99.57 - 90 = 9.57, facing north. The viewer
stood 33 m away at bearing 325 from corner A, on the north side, confirming the sign.
The anchor is the MIDPOINT of the two corners, because BuildingLoader centres the model
SHAPE: a square main block with a NARROWER rectangle in front (entrance + stairs). The
pins span that front rectangle (~17.8 m), NOT the building's widest part, so the model's
X must not be fitted to them. Fitting DEPTH instead: fitMetres 33.4 on axis Z gives
x1.87, i.e. 24.7 m across the block, 15.9 m tall - matching the 0.75 width:depth ratio
of both the model box and the real building.
SUPERSEDES the original pair (facade point + BACK corner). That was a DIAGONAL; using it
as a depth inflated the model and put the heading 45 deg out, which is exactly the -43 to
-49 deg correction dialled in by hand on three separate visits.
